join_google_meet: join a Google Meet call and start scraping live captions into a transcript file
check_meet_status: check the current Meet session state including bot liveness and transcript progress
read_meet_transcript: read the scraped transcript for the active Meet session with optional last N lines
leave_google_meet: leave the active Meet call cleanly and finalize the transcript file
speak_in_meet: speak text into the active Meet call using the realtime audio bridge
